entries: {@i Choose A or B:} (A) {@item Greataxe|XPHB}, 4 {@item Handaxe|XPHB|Handaxes}, {@item Explorer's Pack|XPHB}, and 15 GP; or (B) 75 GP

subclass.name: Path of the Spiritual Guardian
subclassFeatures: Path of the Spiritual Guardian|Barbarian|XPHB|Spiritual Guardian|WoW|3

subclass.name: Path of the World Tree
subclassFeatures: Path of the World Tree|Barbarian|XPHB|World Tree|XPHB|3

classFeature.name: Rage
entries: You can imbue yourself with a primal power called Rage, a force that grants you extraordinary might and resilience. You can enter it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} if you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

You can enter your Rage the number of times shown for your Barbarian level in the Rages column of the Barbarian Features table. You regain one expended use when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
While active, your Rage follows the rules below.

entries.name: Damage Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

entries.name: Rage Damage
entries: When you make an attack using Strength—with either a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}—and deal damage to the target, you gain a bonus to the damage that increases as you gain levels as a Barbarian, as shown in the Rage Damage column of the Barbarian Features table.

entries.name: Strength Advantage
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

entries.name: No Concentration or Spells
entries: You can't maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}, and you can't cast spells.

entries.name: Duration
entries: The Rage lasts until the end of your next turn, and it ends early if you don Heavy armor or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. If your Rage is still active on your next turn, you can extend the Rage for another round by doing one of the following:

items: Make an attack roll against an enemy.
Force an enemy to make a saving throw.
Take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to extend your Rage.

entries: Each time the Rage is extended, it lasts until the end of your next turn. You can maintain a Rage for up to 10 minutes.

classFeature.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While you aren't wearing any armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Constitution modifiers. You can use a {@item Shield|XPHB} and still gain this benefit.

classFeature.name: Weapon Mastery
entries: Your training with weapons allows you to use the {@variantrule weapon mastery properties|XPHB|mastery properties} of two kinds of {@filter Simple|items|type=simple weapon;melee weapon=sand} or {@filter Martial Melee weapons|items|type=martial weapon;melee weapon=sand} of your choice, such as {@item Greataxe|XPHB|Greataxes} and {@item Handaxe|XPHB|Handaxes}. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices.

When you reach certain Barbarian levels, you gain the ability to use the {@variantrule weapon mastery properties|XPHB|mastery properties} of more kinds of weapons, as shown in the Weapon Mastery column of the Barbarian Features table.

classFeature.name: Danger Sense
entries: You gain an uncanny sense of when things aren't as they should be, giving you an edge when you dodge perils. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws unless you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

classFeature.name: Reckless Attack
entries: You can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with increased ferocity. When you make your first attack roll on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls using Strength until the start of your next turn, but attack rolls against you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} during that time.

classFeature.name: Shaman Subclass
entries: You gain a Shaman subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Shaman levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Shaman level or lower.

classFeature.name: Totems
entries: This feature replaces the Barbarian's {@classFeature Primal Knowledge|Barbarian|XPHB|3|XPHB} feature.

You can coalesce elemental spirits into a totem that aids you and your allies. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can plant one of the totems below into the ground in an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of yourself.

A totem is a Small object that has AC 10 and 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} and lasts for 1 minute, until it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, or until you use this feature again. At the end of each of your turns, the totem pulses with elemental energy that fills a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

entries.name: Earthbind Totem
entries: Each enemy in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} has its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Primal Knowledge Totem
entries: Each ally in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} is empowered with nature's focus until the end of your next turn. While empowered in this way, whenever the creature makes an ability check using one of the following skills, the creature can make it as a Strength check even if it normally uses a different ability: {@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}, {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, {@skill Perception|XPHB}, {@skill Stealth|XPHB}, or {@skill Survival|XPHB}. After you plant this totem, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of this totem by expending one use of your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} (no action required).

entries.name: Tremor Totem
entries: Each ally in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions until the end of your next turn. If the creature was already {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, those conditions are suppressed until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Wind Rush Totem
entries: Each ally in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} has its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increased by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Barbarian levels 8, 12, and 16.

classFeature.name: Extra Attack
entries: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn.

classFeature.name: Fast Movement
entries: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Barbarian subclass.

classFeature.name: Feral Instinct
entries: Your instincts are so honed that you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls.

classFeature.name: Instinctive Pounce
entries: As part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} you take to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Brutal Strike
entries: If you use Reckless Attack, you can forgo any {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on one Strength-based attack roll of your choice on your turn. The chosen attack roll mustn't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. If the chosen attack roll hits, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d10} damage of the same type dealt by the weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, and you can cause one Brutal Strike effect of your choice. You have the following effect options.

entries.name: Forceful Blow
entries: The target is pushed 15 feet straight away from you. You can then move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} straight toward the target without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

entries.name: Hamstring Blow
entries: The target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn. A target can be affected by only one Hamstring Blow at a time—the most recent one.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Barbarian subclass.

classFeature.name: Relentless Rage
entries: Your Rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds. If you drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} while your Rage is active and don't die outright, you can make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} instead change to a number equal to twice your Barbarian level.
Each time you use this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, the DC resets to 10.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Improved Brutal Strike
entries: You have honed new ways to attack furiously. The following effects are now among your Brutal Strike options.

entries.name: Staggering Blow
entries: The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next saving throw it makes, and it can't make {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Sundering Blow
entries: Before the start of your next turn, the next attack roll made by another creature against the target gains a +5 bonus to the roll. An attack roll can gain only one Sundering Blow bonus.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Barbarian subclass.

classFeature.name: Persistent Rage
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, you can regain all expended uses of Rage. After you regain uses of Rage in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

In addition, your Rage is so fierce that it now lasts for 10 minutes without you needing to do anything to extend it from round to round. Your Rage ends early if you have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition (not just the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition) or don Heavy armor.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Improved Brutal Strike
entries: The extra damage of your Brutal Strike increases to {@damage 2d10}. In addition, you can use two different Brutal Strike effects whenever you use your Brutal Strike feature.

classFeature.name: Indomitable Might
entries: If your total for a Strength check or Strength saving throw is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.

classFeature.name: Epic Boon
entries: You gain an {@filter Epic Boon feat|feats|category=EB} or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify. {@feat Boon of Irresistible Offense|XPHB} is recommended.

classFeature.name: Primal Champion
entries: You embody primal power. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

subclassFeature.name: Path of the Berserker
entries: {@i Channel Rage into Violent Fury}

Barbarians who walk the Path of the Berserker direct their Rage primarily toward violence. Their path is one of untrammeled fury, and they thrill in the chaos of battle as they allow their Rage to seize and empower them.

subclassFeature.name: Frenzy
entries: If you use Reckless Attack while your Rage is active, you deal extra damage to the first target you hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack. To determine the extra damage, roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together. The damage has the same type as the weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} used for the attack.

subclassFeature.name: Mindless Rage
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions while your Rage is active. If you're {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} when you enter your Rage, the condition ends on you.

subclassFeature.name: Retaliation
entries: When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make one melee attack against that creature, using a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Intimidating Presence
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can strike terror into others with your menacing presence and primal power. When you do so, each creature of your choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Strength modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} creature's turns, the creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeature.name: Path of the Elements
entries: {@i Wield the Fury of the Elements}

Barbarians who follow the Path of the Elements learn to harness their {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} into a storm of flames, frost, and lightning. When in their {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB}, these Barbarians tap into the elemental forces of nature to create powerful magical effects.

subclassFeature.name: Raging Elements
entries: Whenever you activate your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB}, you can take one of the following Raging Elements options of your choice as part of that {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB|rage} is active, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to use that option again or a different option.
If a Raging Elements option requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 plus your Constitution modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Icefury
entries: When this effect is activated, roll a number of d8s equal to your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} Damage bonus, and add them together. You hurl frigid ice at one creature within 30 feet of yourself. Make either a melee spell attack (if the target is within 5 feet) or a ranged spell attack, using Constitution as your spellcasting ability. On a hit, the attack deals Cold damage equal to the number rolled, and the next time the target takes Fire damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an extra {@damage 1d10} Fire damage.

entries.name: Lava Burst
entries: When this effect is activated, roll a number of d4s equal to your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} Damage bonus, and add them together. You then hurl molten lava at one creature you can see within 30 feet. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes Fire damage equal to the number rolled, and the next time the target takes Lightning damage until the end of your next turn, it takes an extra {@damage 1d8} Lightning damage. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

entries.name: Lightning Bolt
entries: When this effect is activated, roll a number of d6s equal to your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} Damage bonus, and add them together. You can then hurl a bolt of lightning at one other creature you can see within 30 feet. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes Lightning damage equal to the roll's total, and the next time the target takes Cold damage until the end of your next turn, it takes an extra {@damage 1d6} Cold damage. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

subclassFeature.name: Echo of the Elements
entries: You tap into the tranquility of the elements. You know the {@spell Elementalism|XPHB} cantrip. In addition, you can expend a use of your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} to cast {@spell Daylight|XPHB}, {@spell Water Walk|XPHB}, or {@spell Wind Wall|XPHB}. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

subclassFeature.name: Primordial Bond
entries: While your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} is active, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage.

subclassFeature.name: Elemental Overload
entries: The power of the storm you channel grows mightier, lashing out at your foes. Your {@subclassFeature Raging Elements|Barbarian|XPHB|Elements|WoW|3|WoW} options gain the following effects.

entries.name: Icefury
entries: Whether or not you hit the target with this option, the target subtracts half the number rolled (round down) from the next damage roll it makes before the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Lava Burst
entries: Whether or not the target fails its saving throw against this option, the target and each enemy within 10 feet of it start {@hazard burning|XPHB}.

entries.name: Lightning Bolt
entries: Whether or not the target fails its saving throw against this option, a bolt of lightning leaps from the target to another target of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of the first target. The new target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking Lightning damage equal to the roll's total on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

subclassFeature.name: Path of the Spiritual Guardian
entries: {@i Call on the Spirits for Combat Aid}

Barbarians who walk the Path of the Spiritual Guardian call on spirits—whether bestial spirits of nature, spirits of departed ancestors, or spirits of raw elemental power—to guide and protect them. When these Barbarians rage, they contact the realm of the spirits and call on them for aid.

subclassFeature.name: Spiritual Protectors
entries: Your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} summons spectral warriors to your aid. While your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} is active, when you hit a creature with a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, that creature becomes a target of the spirits, which cause one of the following effects of your choice.

entries.name: Distract
entries: Until the start of your next turn, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against targets other than you or another Barbarian who has this feature.

entries.name: Hinder
entries: You can activate the {@itemMastery Slow} mastery property in addition to a different mastery property you're using with that weapon.

entries.name: Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d4} damage, which can be Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (your choice).

subclassFeature.name: Spirit Shield
entries: Your guardian spirits can provide supernatural protection to those you defend. While your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} is active, when another creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce that damage. To determine the amount the damage is reduced by, roll a number of d6s equal to your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} Damage bonus, and add them together.

subclassFeature.name: Consult the Spirits
entries: You gain the ability to consult with your guardian spirits. When you do so, you cast the {@spell Augury|XPHB} or {@spell Clairvoyance|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot or needing Material components. Rather than creating a spherical sensor, this use of {@spell Clairvoyance|XPHB} invisibly summons one of your guardian spirits to the chosen location. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
After you cast either spell in this way, you can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Spirits' Fury
entries: Your spirits hasten your attacks. When you make an attack roll with a Melee weapon as part of the {@action Attack|XPHB} action and roll 18–20 on the {@dice d20}, you can make one additional attack roll with the same weapon as part of that action. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Path of the World Tree
entries: {@i Trace the Roots and Branches of the Multiverse}

Barbarians who follow the Path of the World Tree connect with the cosmic tree Yggdrasil through their Rage. This tree grows among the Outer Planes, connecting them to each other and the Material Plane. These Barbarians draw on the tree's magic for vitality and as a means of dimensional travel.

subclassFeature.name: Vitality of the Tree
entries: Your Rage taps into the life force of the World Tree. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Vitality Surge
entries: When you activate your Rage, you gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Barbarian level.

entries.name: Life-Giving Force
entries: At the start of each of your turns while your Rage is active, you can choose another creature within 10 feet of yourself to gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. To determine the number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together. If any of these {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} remain when your Rage ends, they vanish.

subclassFeature.name: Branches of the Tree
entries: Whenever a creature you can see starts its turn within 30 feet of you while your Rage is active, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to summon spectral branches of the World Tree around it. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Strength modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or be teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of yourself or in the nearest unoccupied space you can see. After the target teleports, you can reduce its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} to 0 until the end of the current turn.

subclassFeature.name: Battering Roots
entries: During your turn, your reach is 10 feet greater with any {@filter Melee weapon that has the Heavy or Versatile property|items|type=melee weapon|property=heavy;versatile}, as tendrils of the World Tree extend from you. When you hit with such a weapon on your turn, you can activate the {@itemMastery Push|XPHB} or {@itemMastery Topple|XPHB} mastery property in addition to a different mastery property you're using with that weapon.

subclassFeature.name: Travel Along the Tree
entries: When you activate your Rage and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while your Rage is active, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

In addition, once per Rage, you can increase the range of that teleport to 150 feet. When you do so, you can also bring up to six willing creatures who are within 10 feet of you. Each creature teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice within 10 feet of your destination space.
